name: SPIRV-Reflect

source.verification: The archive of GitHub tag vulkan-sdk-1.4.363.0 (commit f3e261fda74ca81b44d1941931c6b7b5fe236d0e) was downloaded on 2026-11-16 and its SHA-256 recorded. Upstream publishes no signatures or hashes, so it is pinned by the tag commit and the archive hash.

licenses.upstreamExpression: MIT (spirv.h header comment, Khronos SPIR-V headers)

notes: Pinned to the Vulkan SDK 1.4.363.0 tag (the same SDK tag as the DXC v1.9.2609 submodules, same as Vulkan-Headers).
Only the single C translation unit spirv_reflect.c, its header and the bundled spirv.h are kept. The C++ wrapper (spirv_reflect.cpp), examples, tests and tools are not included.
SPIRV_REFLECT_DISABLE_CPP_BINDINGS: the C++ wrapper in spirv_reflect.h includes the STL (<string>, <vector>), so C++ consumer modules use only the C API.
